draftNote: 2 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Cuban Noobster (midlane→carry), Willy Guggenheim (offlane→jungle).

coaching.headline: Serath went 15/8 and it still was not close — the other four of us went a combined 5/28, and a 17/4 Feng Mao ran the map to a 3-10 tower finish.
coaching.team: Four of five lanes read unfavored and the film shows the cost of fighting anyway: they won eight fights to our one, six of us were caught out alone, and the 17.6 fight was lost 1-3 with a man up. The 21.3 teamfight at their Fangtooth — four of us going 0-4 against just Legion and Shinbi — paid out their Fangtooth and Orb Prime in the same minute. Muriel kept their carries standing with 12,920 healing while objective damage finished 16,625 to 66,417; when the reads are this bad, the play is farm, vision and declined fights, not coin-toss brawls in their half.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 0-4 at their Fangtooth at 21.3 — four bodies lost to Legion and Shinbi alone — handed over Fangtooth and Orb Prime at 22 and broke the game open.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Cuban Noobster took first blood on Legion at 2.8 and won the mid lane early, but the matchup was read to flip late and it did — 3/6 by the end, with the 15.9 catch by Sparrow directly costing the 16-minute Fangtooth. Zinx's kit wants to stand next to an ally and keep them alive; alone in the river is the one place it cannot survive.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim drew the lane read 'theirs all game' into Shinbi and it played to script — 0/6, though 18784 mitigated shows he was absorbing pressure rather than throwing. With the lane unwinnable the fixes were map-level: decline fights like the 21.3 0-4 at their Fangtooth, and buy armor — the film flags him and Zinx with none into Sparrow's 31336 physical.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Xeebs' Serath was the entire offense — 15 kills and 34656 hero damage — and it still could not outrun eight deaths against a 17/4 Feng Mao. Serath's dive-and-reset game needs teammates arriving behind the dive; going in ahead of four losing lanes turned half those resets into even trades.

threats: Heal-stacking: Muriel. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

lines: Lead story: Built to deal damage, not to soak it. 1,020 hero damage a minute, more than 81% of Feng Mao jungle players this patch (29% of the team's), while mitigating less than 78% of them. The damage came from Malady, Omen, Mutilator. Died 4 times.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Feng Mao touched shortened Earth Shatter, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 43.8s late); fight right after Earth Shatter is spent.
Earth Shatter at rank 3: 85s base, about 43.8s by the end (48% shorter) from 94 ability haste: Malady 8, Omen 10, Mutilator 15, The Perforator 15, Witchstalker 8, Lotus 38.
23 takedowns (17 kills, 6 assists) fed: Malady (Demise), Nightfall (Dusk Reaver), Lotus (Eternal), Executioners Path (passive).

Omen (Bestial Momentum): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum.• At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit.• Deal 30 (+20%) Damage.• Reduce your Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 20%.

Feng Mao dealt 30,591 hero damage, 29% of their team's, with +252 physical power from items.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 6 effects on one trigger: Malady, Mutilator, Nightfall, The Perforator, Witchstalker, Lotus. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Every takedown fed): 3 effects on one trigger: Malady, Nightfall, Lotus. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, Nightfall, Witchstalker.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Mutilator, The Perforator. Feng Mao has 3 damaging abilities (Reaping Dash, Hamstring, Earth Shatter hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 94 ability haste brought them back 48% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Omen, Mutilator.

The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Early Bloom + Prima Donna) sits on the same triggers as the items (kept alive in fights; every takedown fed), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 2 of the 5 players Feng Mao killed built physical armor (Phase, Serath). Anti-heal on Murdock, Phase, Serath. We killed Feng Mao 4 times.
Copy it? Lotus (Early Bloom + Prima Donna): 55.8% in 147 Feng Mao jungle games, above the hero's 46.9%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

loadout.name: Seismic Smash
loadout.text: Earth Shatter also Knocks Up Enemies and Stuns for a short duration.

ability.name: Earth Shatter
ability.what: Feng Mao slams his glaive into the ground, dealing 225/300/375 (+40%) physical damage to all Enemies in the area.

loadout.plain: Earth Shatter also knocks up and stuns, so it locks enemies in place even when it does not execute. Land it on a group to start or finish a fight.

loadout.name: Lotus
loadout.text: Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
numbers: 38 random bonuses this game (every 2 min plus 23 takedowns), 1 in 4 each: about +9.5% damage, about +38 ability haste, about +7.1% move speed, about +11.9% max health (expected)
loadout.plain: A random small stat bonus every couple of minutes and on every takedown. Nothing specific to Feng Mao's kit; it grows slowly if you get takedowns.

loadout.name: Early Bloom
loadout.text: Gain an additional Level upon reaching Level 12.
loadout.plain: One extra level at level 12, so your ability ranks come a little earlier. A generic power bump.

loadout.name: Prima Donna
loadout.text: Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.
loadout.plain: More damage to heroes but you take more from everything. Risky on a melee fighter who dives with Reaping Dash.

loadout.name: Witchstalker
loadout.text: Purifying Strike:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Empower your next Damage Instance within 8s. Deal 4% Target Max Health as Damage. Double the Damage if a Debuff is Cleansed. Heal equal to the Damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Removes crowd control and empowers your next hit with damage based on the target's max health that also heals you. Use it after being slowed, then hit with Hamstring.

lead.title: Built to deal damage, not to soak it
lead.text: 1,020 hero damage a minute, more than 81% of Feng Mao jungle players this patch (29% of the team's), while mitigating less than 78% of them. The damage came from Malady, Omen, Mutilator. Died 4 times.
lead.lesson: Feng Mao built for damage with little to soak it: focus Feng Mao first in fights and the damage leaves with them (a plan, not something the data shows happened).

loadout.name: Crushing Descent
loadout.text: Ascend now Stuns for 0.2s when it deals damage.

ability.name: Ascend
ability.what: Serath rises up into the air and hovers for up to 1.8s.

loadout.plain: Ascend now briefly stuns what it lands on. A 0.2s stun is short, but it can interrupt a dash or channel as you dive in to start the fight.

loadout.name: Thraex
loadout.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).
loadout.plain: The last hero you basic attack takes more damage from you and deals less to you. It favors locking onto one target and staying on them with Chastise resets.

loadout.name: Savage Strikes
loadout.text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.
loadout.plain: Extra physical damage on each hit that ramps against heroes and heals you. Chastise applies on-hit to everyone it hits, so it spreads this to a group.

loadout.name: Ferocity
loadout.text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: Attack speed that keeps stacking the longer you stay in hero combat. It rewards long fights, especially during Heresy when you are attacking nonstop.

loadout.name: Liberator
loadout.text: Purifying Guard:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.
loadout.plain: Removes every debuff and gives you a shield. Save it to break the crowd control that lands on you after Heaven's Fury or Ascend puts you in the middle.

fedBy: Fallen Grace (passive): Takedowns on Enemy Heroes leave behind a demonic visage for 10s. Upon touching it, Serath activates Heresy at no cost and reduces her current basic ability cooldowns by 65%.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,155 hero damage a minute, more than 89% of Serath jungle players this patch (35% of the team's). The damage came from Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds, Absolution.
Heresy at rank 3: 85s base, about 68s by the end (20% shorter) from 25 ability haste: Spectra 10, Draconum 15.
17 takedowns (15 kills, 2 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow), Fallen Grace (passive).
Serath dealt 34,656 hero damage, 35% of their team's, with +157 physical power from items.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Absolution (item): On being Immobilized: Gain 25% Damage Mitigation. Gain 40% Movement Speed. Lasts 3s.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.

Thraex (Eternal): Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.; Savage Strikes: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.; 7,892 healing recorded.
Toughness: +40 physical armor, +40 magical armor, +25% tenacity; took 38,070 damage, mitigated 23,579, died 8 times.

(game text: Ascend now Stuns for 0.2s when it deals damage.) (changes Ascend, 11.2s cooldown with their haste) Field: 50.3% in 5208 games, 54% of picks, above the hero-role's 49.2%.

Loadout Eternal Thraex: The last hero you basic attack takes more damage from you and deals less to you. It favors locking onto one target and staying on them with Chastise resets. (game text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).) Field: 46.9% in 2826 games, 30% of picks, below the hero-role's 49.2%.

Loadout minor Savage Strikes: Extra physical damage on each hit that ramps against heroes and heals you. Chastise applies on-hit to everyone it hits, so it spreads this to a group. (game text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.) [1.5 + 0.4 a level: 8.3 at level 17] Field: 47.1% in 2756 games, 98% of picks, below the hero-role's 49.2%.

Loadout minor Ferocity: Attack speed that keeps stacking the longer you stay in hero combat. It rewards long fights, especially during Heresy when you are attacking nonstop. (game text: Gain 1% Total Attack Speed per 1s in Hero Combat, stacking infinitely.) Field: 46.4% in 2636 games, 93% of picks, below the hero-role's 49.2%.

Loadout crest Liberator: Removes every debuff and gives you a shield. Save it to break the crowd control that lands on you after Heaven's Fury or Ascend puts you in the middle. (game text: Purifying Guard:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.) Field: 50.5% in 1458 games, 15% of picks, above the hero-role's 49.2%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 5 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds, Spectra, Thraex, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 4 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Draconum, Liberator, Savage Strikes.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 2 effects on one trigger: Liberator, Savage Strikes. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage; kept alive in fights), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 0 of the 5 players Serath killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Shinbi, Sparrow. We killed Serath 8 times.

Copy it? Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 46.6% in 2,581 Serath jungle games, below the hero's 49.2%; this 3-item core: 50.2% in 1,015 games, below the 52.3% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

members.text: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.

members.name: Spectra
members.text: On Basic Attacks: Deal 20 Damage On-Hit. Reduces the Cooldown of Prisma by 3s. Applies a stack of Prism to Heroes & Monsters for 2.5s, stacking up to 3 times. If the Target has 3 Prism stacks on them, trigger Prisma.

members.name: Thraex
members.text: Mark the last Enemy Hero damaged by your Basic Attack for 3s, increasing your damage against them by 3% (+0.4% per level) and reducing the damage they deal to you by 1.5% (+0.35% per level).

members.name: Savage Strikes
members.text: Deal 1.5 (+0.4 per level) Physical Damage On-Hit. Attacking an Enemy Hero increases this by 100% for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. Heal for the damage dealt.

stacks.text: 2 effects on one trigger: Liberator, Savage Strikes. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

worked.eternalPart: The Eternal was part of it: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage; kept alive in fights), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.

countered.text: 0 of the 5 players Serath killed built physical armor.

copy.text: Thraex (Savage Strikes + Ferocity): 46.6% in 2,581 Serath jungle games, below the hero's 49.2%; this 3-item core: 50.2% in 1,015 games, below the 52.3% of that hero-role's cores. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
